## Description

Trains deep reinforcement learning execution agents inside a Wasserstein ambiguity set of transition probabilities, guaranteeing robust worst-case performance against simulated market impact model errors.

## Where it may fit

Large institutional block order execution, illiquid asset liquidation under uncertain market impact.

## Vehicles

Agency execution brokers, algorithmic execution desks, institutional asset managers.

## Required data

Historical limit order book depth profiles, volume participation curves, temporary/permanent impact coefficients.

## Caveats

Robust MDP formulation increases training computational overhead significantly compared to standard RL.
